title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting UPDATE is still the unguarded update_reference_call_status — the guarded mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person is unwired and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235-1257: `case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(...) False -> case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_wrong_person(...) False -> case sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated) {...` — update_reference_call_status.sql: `WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause); mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql HAS `AND taken_over_at IS NULL` but grep of server/src shows its only callers are the tests at integration line 1746/1758: `rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)` — direct SQL, never the handler.

The guarded SQL exists but is unwired; the pin drives the SQL directly and cannot catch an unwired backstop.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's cycles=0 branch; rewrite the race test to drive handle_wrong_person_post through the router with a pre-taken-over row so neutralizing the backstop turns it red.

title: Wrong-person awaiting UPDATE also lacks the correction_cycles backstop — a correction + sweep T0-claim racing the read re-enters a corrected row into awaiting_correction and enables a second correction (AD-7 cycle cap violated)
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1242-1243: `case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_wrong_person(...)` then the False branch calls the unguarded `sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, ...)` (WHERE id + status only). mark_awaiting_correction.sql gained `AND correction_cycles = 0`, but mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql has only `AND status = 'contact_initiated'::reference_call_status AND taken_over_at IS NULL` — no cycles guard.
detail: Read-time cycles check is TOCTOU-racy: correction (queued, cycles=1) + sweep T0 claim (contact_initiated) landing between read and UPDATE still matches the status guard, re-entering a corrected row into awaiting_correction where do_correct (status='awaiting_correction') runs a second correction (cycles=2).
recommended_fix: Add `AND correction_cycles = 0` to mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql (mirroring mark_awaiting_correction) and wire it in — the same fix as the take-over backstop closes both race partners.
